entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Amaru II, a notable figure in the history of Bolivia, associated with Colonial Upper Peru: The Silver Colony (1700–1782). Preceded by Viceroy Toledo institutes the mita forced labor system and Potosí produces over half the world's silver supply in the 17th century. Their legacy influenced Túpac Katari besieges La Paz for 184 days and Execution of Túpac Katari — 'I will return as millions' — November 15, 1781.
